scope: Active canonical set quality-report inventory, all measured rows game=pokemon. Not an authoritative expected universe or full product/card/variant/image census.
readOnlyQuery: select current_timestamp as observed_at,set_id,game_code,language_code,native_name,expected_card_total,expected_set_total,imported_set_total from ingest.catalogue_quality_report [where set_id > :last_id::uuid] order by set_id limit 250

japaneseLegacyReferenceRecheck.limitation: Re-executed current legacy-reference query; historical immutable ID list not supplied, so equal counts do not prove frozen cohort identity.

api.failure: Second request using Python urllib returned HTTP403; no bypass or population-wide failure inference.

handoff: Release owner: run exact-head Platform CI including lint/typecheck/typecheck:backend/test:catalogue-ingestion, review and merge tooling only. Then use existing read-only quality-report path against explicit target, save pagination flags and byGameAndLanguage; no app deploy or import required.
